args.subject: Re: Offer of help
args.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks so much for offering — that's really kind, and five hours a week could go a long way.

Right now I'm in the early stages of setting Halcyon Threshold up. A few things that would be genuinely useful:

1. **Research & landscape mapping** — helping me figure out what's neglected in AI safety/governance (e.g., which evals, standards, or research gaps are under-resourced).
2. **Data analysis** — if we end up running any kind of eval or survey, I'd need help designing and analyzing it.
3. **Grant/proposal review** — I'm drafting an Emberfall rapid grant application; a second pair of eyes on the budget and narrative would be helpful.

One constraint: I'm still clearing an outside-activities disclosure with my employer, so I can't put my name (or Halcyon Threshold's) on anything public — press, open letters, public posts — until that's done. Behind-the-scenes research and writing is fine.

Does any of that sound like a good fit for what you had in mind? If so, I can send over a first task or two.

Best,
Morgan
Halcyon Threshold

args.content:
Halcyon Threshold

A small, independent effort to help the arrival of superintelligent AI go well.

Halcyon Threshold is a personal project started by Morgan Hale. The belief behind it is straightforward: the arrival of superintelligence is one of the most consequential events of our time, and far too few people outside the frontier labs are thinking seriously about how to make it go well.

What this is

An early-stage, independent effort operating on evenings and weekends. No staff, no institutional backing, no grand plan — just a commitment to figure out where one person can be useful, and then do that work.

What we're exploring

  • Mapping neglected gaps in AI safety and governance research
  • Independent evaluations and measurement work
  • Small-scale grantmaking to under-resourced projects
  • A reading group for people new to the field

None of this is launched yet. This site is a placeholder while the work gets off the ground.

Get in touch

If you're working on something in this space and think it might overlap with what Halcyon Threshold is doing, I'd like to hear from you.

morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

Note: I'm currently sorting out an outside-activities disclosure with my employer, so I may not be able to be listed publicly on statements, letters, or press pieces just yet. Behind-the-scenes collaboration is fine.
